parameters.sqlQuery: =WITH course_map AS ( SELECT LOWER(TRIM(course_key)) AS raw_key, course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != '' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a)), course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`, UNNEST(SPLIT(IFNULL(aliases, ''), ',')) AS a WHERE TRIM(a) != '' AND course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != '' ), base AS ( SELECT d.*, LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''), r'\s+', ' '))) AS raw_key FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''), 'Trash:') ), vde AS ( SELECT b.* EXCEPT(raw_key), IFNULL(m.course_key, CONCAT('[unmapped] ', b.raw_key)) AS course_key_norm, IFNULL(m.course_name, IF(b.raw_key = '', '[CHUA CHON KHOA]', CONCAT('[CHUA MAP] ', b.selected_course))) AS course_name_norm, IFNULL(m.course_type, 'Chua phan loai') AS course_type_norm, m.report_day AS report_day, IFNULL(m.is_active, FALSE) AS is_active_course, (m.course_key IS NULL) AS is_unmapped FROM base b LEFT JOIN course_map m ON m.raw_key = b.raw_key AND b.raw_key != '' ), p AS ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS d, DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS curr_start, DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS curr_end, DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AS prev_start, DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 8 DAY) AS prev_end ), leads AS ( SELECT IF(DATE(created_at) BETWEEN p.curr_start AND p.curr_end, 'curr', 'prev') AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT deal_id) AS total_leads, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(stage_id IN (224,264,267,268,265,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,220,221,217,222,218,219,75,76,73,74,79,80,1328,1329,1330,1331,1332), deal_id, NULL)) AS mql, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(stage_id IN (224,267,268,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,220,221,222,218,219,75,76,74,80,1329,1330,1331,1332), deal_id, NULL)) AS sql_discovery, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(stage_id IN (224,267,268,92,91,227,228,225,229,226,220,221,222,219,75,76,1330,1331,1332), deal_id, NULL)) AS sql_needfit FROM vde, p WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.curr_end GROUP BY period ), outcomes AS ( SELECT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.curr_start AND p.curr_end, 'curr', 'prev') AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(deal_status = 'won', deal_id, NULL)) AS won_deals, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(deal_status = 'lost', deal_id, NULL)) AS lost_deals FROM vde, p WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.curr_end GROUP BY period ), yesterday AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(created_at) = p.d, deal_id, NULL)) AS leads_yesterday, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(deal_status='won' AND DATE(closed_at) = p.d, deal_id, NULL)) AS won_yesterday FROM vde, p ), combined AS ( SELECT COALESCE(l.period, o.period) AS period, COALESCE(l.total_leads,0) / 7 AS avg_leads_per_day, COALESCE(l.mql,0) / 7 AS avg_mql_per_day, COALESCE(l.sql_discovery,0) / 7 AS avg_sql_discovery_per_day, COALESCE(l.sql_needfit,0) / 7 AS avg_sql_needfit_per_day, COALESCE(o.won_deals,0) / 7 AS avg_won_per_day, COALESCE(o.lost_deals,0) / 7 AS avg_lost_per_day, SAFE_DIVIDE(o.won_deals, o.won_deals + o.lost_deals) AS conversion_rate FROM leads l FULL OUTER JOIN outcomes o USING (period) ), pivot AS ( SELECT MAX(IF(period='curr', avg_leads_per_day, NULL)) AS curr_leads, MAX(IF(period='prev', avg_leads_per_day, NULL)) AS prev_leads, MAX(IF(period='curr', avg_mql_per_day, NULL)) AS curr_mql, MAX(IF(period='prev', avg_mql_per_day, NULL)) AS prev_mql, MAX(IF(period='curr', avg_sql_discovery_per_day, NULL)) AS curr_sql_discovery, MAX(IF(period='prev', avg_sql_discovery_per_day, NULL)) AS prev_sql_discovery, MAX(IF(period='curr', avg_sql_needfit_per_day, NULL)) AS curr_sql_needfit, MAX(IF(period='prev', avg_sql_needfit_per_day, NULL)) AS prev_sql_needfit, MAX(IF(period='curr', avg_won_per_day, NULL)) AS curr_won, MAX(IF(period='prev', avg_won_per_day, NULL)) AS prev_won, MAX(IF(period='curr', avg_lost_per_day, NULL)) AS curr_lost, MAX(IF(period='prev', avg_lost_per_day, NULL)) AS prev_lost, MAX(IF(period='curr', conversion_rate, NULL)) AS curr_cvr, MAX(IF(period='prev', conversion_rate, NULL)) AS prev_cvr FROM combined ) SELECT p.d AS report_date, y.leads_yesterday, y.won_yesterday, pv.curr_leads AS leads_avg7, SAFE_DIVIDE(pv.curr_leads - pv.prev_leads, NULLIF(pv.prev_leads,0)) AS leads_pct_change, pv.curr_won AS won_avg7, SAFE_DIVIDE(pv.curr_won - pv.prev_won, NULLIF(pv.prev_won,0)) AS won_pct_change, pv.curr_mql AS mql_avg7, SAFE_DIVIDE(pv.curr_mql - pv.prev_mql, NULLIF(pv.prev_mql,0)) AS mql_pct_change, pv.curr_sql_discovery AS sql_discovery_avg7, SAFE_DIVIDE(pv.curr_sql_discovery - pv.prev_sql_discovery, NULLIF(pv.prev_sql_discovery,0)) AS sql_discovery_pct_change, pv.curr_sql_needfit AS sql_needfit_avg7, SAFE_DIVIDE(pv.curr_sql_needfit - pv.prev_sql_needfit, NULLIF(pv.prev_sql_needfit,0)) AS sql_needfit_pct_change, pv.curr_lost AS lost_avg7, SAFE_DIVIDE(pv.curr_lost - pv.prev_lost, NULLIF(pv.prev_lost,0)) AS lost_pct_change, pv.curr_cvr AS conversion_rate, pv.curr_cvr - pv.prev_cvr AS cvr_change_pp FROM p, yesterday y, pivot pv

parameters.sqlQuery: =WITH course_map AS ( SELECT LOWER(TRIM(course_key)) AS raw_key, course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != '' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a)), course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`, UNNEST(SPLIT(IFNULL(aliases, ''), ',')) AS a WHERE TRIM(a) != '' AND course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != '' ), base AS ( SELECT d.*, LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''), r'\s+', ' '))) AS raw_key FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''), 'Trash:') ), vde AS ( SELECT b.* EXCEPT(raw_key), IFNULL(m.course_key, CONCAT('[unmapped] ', b.raw_key)) AS course_key_norm, IFNULL(m.course_name, IF(b.raw_key = '', '[CHUA CHON KHOA]', CONCAT('[CHUA MAP] ', b.selected_course))) AS course_name_norm, IFNULL(m.course_type, 'Chua phan loai') AS course_type_norm, m.report_day AS report_day, IFNULL(m.is_active, FALSE) AS is_active_course, (m.course_key IS NULL) AS is_unmapped FROM base b LEFT JOIN course_map m ON m.raw_key = b.raw_key AND b.raw_key != '' ), p AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS d), l AS ( SELECT course_type_norm, course_name_norm, COUNT(DISTINCT deal_id) AS leads FROM vde, p WHERE DATE(created_at) = p.d AND NOT is_unmapped GROUP BY 1,2 ), w AS ( SELECT course_type_norm, course_name_norm, COUNT(DISTINCT deal_id) AS deals FROM vde, p WHERE deal_status = 'won' AND DATE(closed_at) = p.d AND NOT is_unmapped GROUP BY 1,2 ) SELECT COALESCE(l.course_type_norm, w.course_type_norm) AS course_type, COALESCE(l.course_name_norm, w.course_name_norm) AS course_name, IFNULL(l.leads, 0) AS leads, IFNULL(w.deals, 0) AS deals FROM l FULL OUTER JOIN w ON l.course_type_norm = w.course_type_norm AND l.course_name_norm = w.course_name_norm ORDER BY course_type, deals DESC, leads DESC

parameters.sqlQuery: =WITH course_map AS ( SELECT LOWER(TRIM(course_key)) AS raw_key, course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != '' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a)), course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`, UNNEST(SPLIT(IFNULL(aliases, ''), ',')) AS a WHERE TRIM(a) != '' AND course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != '' ), base AS ( SELECT d.*, LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''), r'\s+', ' '))) AS raw_key FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''), 'Trash:') ), vde AS ( SELECT b.* EXCEPT(raw_key), IFNULL(m.course_key, CONCAT('[unmapped] ', b.raw_key)) AS course_key_norm, IFNULL(m.course_name, IF(b.raw_key = '', '[CHUA CHON KHOA]', CONCAT('[CHUA MAP] ', b.selected_course))) AS course_name_norm, IFNULL(m.course_type, 'Chua phan loai') AS course_type_norm, m.report_day AS report_day, IFNULL(m.is_active, FALSE) AS is_active_course, (m.course_key IS NULL) AS is_unmapped FROM base b LEFT JOIN course_map m ON m.raw_key = b.raw_key AND b.raw_key != '' ), p AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS d), last_lead AS ( SELECT course_key_norm, MAX(DATE(created_at)) AS last_lead_date FROM vde GROUP BY course_key_norm ) SELECT c.course_type, c.course_name, ll.last_lead_date, DATE_DIFF(p.d, IFNULL(ll.last_lead_date, DATE_SUB(p.d, INTERVAL 999 DAY)), DAY) AS days_no_lead FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` c CROSS JOIN p LEFT JOIN last_lead ll ON ll.course_key_norm = c.course_key WHERE c.is_active AND (ll.last_lead_date IS NULL OR ll.last_lead_date < p.d) ORDER BY days_no_lead DESC

parameters.sqlQuery: =WITH course_map AS ( SELECT LOWER(TRIM(course_key)) AS raw_key, course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != '' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a)), course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`, UNNEST(SPLIT(IFNULL(aliases, ''), ',')) AS a WHERE TRIM(a) != '' AND course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != '' ), base AS ( SELECT d.*, LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''), r'\s+', ' '))) AS raw_key FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''), 'Trash:') ), vde AS ( SELECT b.* EXCEPT(raw_key), IFNULL(m.course_key, CONCAT('[unmapped] ', b.raw_key)) AS course_key_norm, IFNULL(m.course_name, IF(b.raw_key = '', '[CHUA CHON KHOA]', CONCAT('[CHUA MAP] ', b.selected_course))) AS course_name_norm, IFNULL(m.course_type, 'Chua phan loai') AS course_type_norm, m.report_day AS report_day, IFNULL(m.is_active, FALSE) AS is_active_course, (m.course_key IS NULL) AS is_unmapped FROM base b LEFT JOIN course_map m ON m.raw_key = b.raw_key AND b.raw_key != '' ), p AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS d), lead_win AS ( SELECT course_key_norm, COUNTIF(DATE(created_at) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND d) AS lead_now, COUNTIF(DATE(created_at) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 13 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS lead_prev FROM vde, p WHERE DATE(created_at) >= DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 13 DAY) GROUP BY course_key_norm ), deal_win AS ( SELECT course_key_norm, COUNTIF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND d) AS deal_now, COUNTIF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 13 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS deal_prev FROM vde, p WHERE deal_status = 'won' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(closed_at) >= DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 13 DAY) GROUP BY course_key_norm ), no_lead AS ( SELECT c.course_key, DATE_DIFF(p.d, IFNULL(MAX(DATE(v.created_at)), DATE_SUB(p.d, INTERVAL 999 DAY)), DAY) AS days_no_lead FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` c CROSS JOIN p LEFT JOIN vde v ON v.course_key_norm = c.course_key WHERE c.is_active GROUP BY c.course_key, p.d ), activity_agg AS ( SELECT deal_id, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deal_activities` GROUP BY deal_id ), pending AS ( SELECT v.course_key_norm, COUNT(DISTINCT v.deal_id) AS pending_leads FROM vde v LEFT JOIN activity_agg a ON a.deal_id = v.deal_id CROSS JOIN p WHERE v.deal_status = 'open' AND IFNULL(a.activity_count, 0) = 0 AND DATE(v.created_at) <= DATE_SUB(p.d, INTERVAL {{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.warning_pending_days }} DAY) GROUP BY v.course_key_norm ), open_deal AS ( SELECT course_key_norm, COUNT(DISTINCT deal_id) AS stale_open_deals FROM vde WHERE deal_status = 'open' AND stage_start_at IS NOT NULL AND DATETIME_DIFF(CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), stage_start_at, DAY) > {{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.warning_open_deal_days }} GROUP BY course_key_norm ) SELECT c.course_type, c.course_name, ROUND(IFNULL(lw.lead_now,0)/7, 2) AS lead_per_day_now, ROUND(IFNULL(lw.lead_prev,0)/7, 2) AS lead_per_day_prev, SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(lw.lead_now,0) - IFNULL(lw.lead_prev,0), NULLIF(lw.lead_prev,0)) * 100 AS lead_delta_pct, ROUND(IFNULL(dw.deal_now,0)/7, 2) AS deal_per_day_now, ROUND(IFNULL(dw.deal_prev,0)/7, 2) AS deal_per_day_prev, SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(dw.deal_now,0) - IFNULL(dw.deal_prev,0), NULLIF(dw.deal_prev,0)) * 100 AS deal_delta_pct, nl.days_no_lead, IFNULL(pd.pending_leads, 0) AS pending_leads, IFNULL(od.stale_open_deals, 0) AS stale_open_deals, (IFNULL(lw.lead_prev,0) >= {{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.min_base_volume }} AND SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(lw.lead_now,0) - lw.lead_prev, lw.lead_prev) * 100 <= -{{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.warning_drop_pct }}) AS flag_lead_drop, (IFNULL(dw.deal_prev,0) >= {{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.min_base_volume }} AND SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(dw.deal_now,0) - dw.deal_prev, dw.deal_prev) * 100 <= -{{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.warning_drop_pct }}) AS flag_deal_drop, (nl.days_no_lead >= {{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.warning_zero_lead_days }}) AS flag_no_lead, (IFNULL(pd.pending_leads,0) >= {{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.warning_pending_min_count }}) AS flag_pending, (IFNULL(od.stale_open_deals,0) >= {{ $('Config').item.json.thresholds.warning_open_deal_min }}) AS flag_stale_open FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` c LEFT JOIN lead_win lw ON lw.course_key_norm = c.course_key LEFT JOIN deal_win dw ON dw.course_key_norm = c.course_key LEFT JOIN no_lead nl ON nl.course_key = c.course_key LEFT JOIN pending pd ON pd.course_key_norm = c.course_key LEFT JOIN open_deal od ON od.course_key_norm = c.course_key WHERE c.is_active ORDER BY lead_delta_pct ASC NULLS LAST

COUNTIF(DATE(v.closed_at) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 36 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS n_p30, COUNTIF(DATE(v.closed_at) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 96 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS n_p90 FROM vde v, p WHERE v.deal_status = 'won' AND v.course_key_norm IN (SELECT course_key FROM scope) AND v.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(v.closed_at) >= DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 96 DAY) GROUP BY v.course_key_norm ) SELECT s.course_type, s.course_name, ROUND(IFNULL(la.n_now,0)/7, 2) AS lead_pd_now, ROUND(IFNULL(la.n_p7,0)/7, 2) AS lead_pd_prev7, ROUND(IFNULL(la.n_p30,0)/30, 2) AS lead_pd_prev30, ROUND(IFNULL(la.n_p90,0)/90, 2) AS lead_pd_prev90, ROUND(IFNULL(da.n_now,0)/7, 2) AS deal_pd_now, ROUND(IFNULL(da.n_p7,0)/7, 2) AS deal_pd_prev7, ROUND(IFNULL(da.n_p30,0)/30, 2) AS deal_pd_prev30, ROUND(IFNULL(da.n_p90,0)/90, 2) AS deal_pd_prev90 FROM scope s LEFT JOIN lead_agg la ON la.course_key_norm = s.course_key LEFT JOIN deal_agg da ON da.course_key_norm = s.course_key ORDER BY deal_pd_now DESC

parameters.sqlQuery:
=WITH course_map AS (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(course_key)) AS raw_key, course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`
  WHERE course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a)), course_key, course_name, course_type, report_day, is_active
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course`, UNNEST(SPLIT(IFNULL(aliases, ''), ',')) AS a
  WHERE TRIM(a) != '' AND course_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(course_key) != ''
), base AS (
  SELECT d.*, LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(d.selected_course, ''), r'\s+', ' '))) AS raw_key
  FROM `tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals` d
  WHERE NOT STARTS_WITH(IFNULL(d.failed_reason_id, ''), 'Trash:')
), vde AS (
  SELECT b.* EXCEPT(raw_key),
    IFNULL(m.course_key, CONCAT('[unmapped] ', b.raw_key)) AS course_key_norm,
    IFNULL(m.course_name, IF(b.raw_key = '', '[CHUA CHON KHOA]', CONCAT('[CHUA MAP] ', b.selected_course))) AS course_name_norm,
    IFNULL(m.course_type, 'Chua phan loai') AS course_type_norm,
    m.report_day, IFNULL(m.is_active, FALSE) AS is_active_course, (m.course_key IS NULL) AS is_unmapped
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN course_map m ON m.raw_key = b.raw_key AND b.raw_key != ''
),
p AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 5 DAY) AS curr_start,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS curr_end,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 12 DAY) AS prev_start,
    DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), INTERVAL 8 DAY) AS prev_end
), lead_agg AS (
  SELECT course_key_norm,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(created_at) BETWEEN p.curr_start AND p.curr_end, deal_id, NULL)) AS leads_this_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(created_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.prev_end, deal_id, NULL)) AS leads_last_week
  FROM vde, p
  WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.curr_end
  GROUP BY course_key_norm
), close_agg AS (
  SELECT course_key_norm,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.curr_start AND p.curr_end AND deal_status='won', deal_id, NULL)) AS won_this_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.curr_start AND p.curr_end AND deal_status='lost', deal_id, NULL)) AS lost_this_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.prev_end AND deal_status='won', deal_id, NULL)) AS won_last_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.prev_end AND deal_status='lost', deal_id, NULL)) AS lost_last_week
  FROM vde, p
  WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(closed_at) BETWEEN p.prev_start AND p.curr_end
  GROUP BY course_key_norm
)
SELECT c.course_type, c.course_name,
  IFNULL(l.leads_this_week,0) AS leads_this_week,
  IFNULL(l.leads_last_week,0) AS leads_last_week,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(l.leads_this_week,0)-IFNULL(l.leads_last_week,0), NULLIF(l.leads_last_week,0))*100 AS lead_delta_pct,
  IFNULL(d.won_this_week,0) AS won_this_week,
  IFNULL(d.lost_this_week,0) AS lost_this_week,
  IFNULL(d.won_last_week,0) AS won_last_week,
  IFNULL(d.lost_last_week,0) AS lost_last_week,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(d.won_this_week, d.won_this_week+d.lost_this_week) AS conversion_rate_this_week,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(d.won_last_week, d.won_last_week+d.lost_last_week) AS conversion_rate_last_week,
  (SAFE_DIVIDE(d.won_this_week,d.won_this_week+d.lost_this_week)-SAFE_DIVIDE(d.won_last_week,d.won_last_week+d.lost_last_week))*100 AS cvr_change_pp
FROM `tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course` c
LEFT JOIN lead_agg l ON l.course_key_norm=c.course_key
LEFT JOIN close_agg d ON d.course_key_norm=c.course_key
WHERE c.is_active
ORDER BY won_this_week DESC, conversion_rate_this_week DESC, leads_this_week DESC

options.systemMessage:
Bạn là Brief Writer của Tomorrow Marketers. Chỉ diễn giải số có trong JSON, không tự tính, không bịa và tuyệt đối không nhắc revenue/doanh thu.

CVR content là CVR cohort hiện tại. (not set) là không tracking/lead tay, không gọi là content.
Không phân tích nguyên nhân sâu; khối 🔍 AI ANALYZE sẽ được RCA tạo sau.

Chỉ dùng tmdatabase.dm_base_crm.deals, stages, pipelines, deal_activities và tmdatabase.dm_daily_brief.dim_course. Deal phải loại failed_reason_id bắt đầu bằng Trash:. deal_activities phải aggregate theo deal_id trước khi JOIN. Luôn có cửa sổ thời gian tối đa 90 ngày và LIMIT không quá 200. Không dùng SELECT *. Trả JSON thuần, không markdown: {"state":<chép nguyên state>,"hypothesis":"...","rationale":"...","sql":"SELECT ... LIMIT 200"}.

nodes.notes: AI đọc kết quả query và quyết định có lặp tiếp hay không.

nodes.name: Normalize RCA Evaluation

parameters.jsCode: function parse(v){ if(typeof v==='object')return v; let s=String(v||'').trim(); const fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3); if(s.startsWith(fence)) s=s.slice(3).replace(/^json/i,'').trim(); if(s.endsWith(fence)) s=s.slice(0,-3).trim(); return JSON.parse(s); } let input; try{ input=$('Aggregate RCA Results').item.json; }catch(e){ input=$('Aggregate RCA Results').first().json; } let ev; try{ ev=parse($json.output||$json.text||$json); }catch(e){ ev={finding:'Không đọc được đánh giá RCA: '+e.message,continue:false,reason:'Evaluator trả JSON lỗi'}; } const state=input.state||{}; const history=[...(state.history||[]),{iteration:state.iteration,hypothesis:input.hypothesis,sql:input.sql,result_rows:input.result_rows,finding:ev.finding||'',reason:ev.reason||'',sql_valid:true}]; const should=Boolean(ev.continue)&&Number(state.iteration||1)<Number(state.max_loops||3); return [{json:{...state,iteration:Number(state.iteration||1)+1,invalid_streak:0,history,should_continue:should}}];

nodes.notes: Cập nhật accumulator sau một query hợp lệ.

nodes.name: Record Guardrail Failure

parameters.jsCode: const g=$json; const s=g.state||{}; const streak=Number(s.invalid_streak||0)+1; const history=[...(s.history||[]),{iteration:s.iteration,hypothesis:g.hypothesis||'',sql:g.sql||'',finding:'SQL bị guardrail từ chối: '+(g.guardrail_reason||'không rõ'),reason:g.guardrail_reason||'',sql_valid:false}]; const should=streak<2&&Number(s.iteration||1)<Number(s.max_loops||3); return [{json:{...s,iteration:Number(s.iteration||1)+1,invalid_streak:streak,history,should_continue:should}}];

nodes.notes: Dừng sau 2 lỗi guardrail liên tiếp hoặc khi hết vòng.

nodes.name: Continue RCA?
nodes.notes: True quay lại Planner; false tổng hợp findings.

nodes.name: RCA Finalizer

parameters.jsCode: const history=$json.history||[]; const findings=history.filter(h=>h.sql_valid&&h.finding).map(h=>'- '+h.finding); const failures=history.filter(h=>!h.sql_valid).length; let text=findings.length?findings.join('\n'):'- Chưa đủ dữ liệu để kết luận nguyên nhân; cần kiểm tra thủ công.'; if(failures) text+='\n- Ghi chú kỹ thuật: '+failures+' truy vấn bị guardrail từ chối và không được chạy.'; return [{json:{root_cause_text:text,history,payload:$json.payload,brief_text:$json.brief_text}}];

nodes.notes: Tổng hợp finding có bằng chứng thành khối AI ANALYZE.

nodes.name: Agent 3 - Action Advisor

options.systemMessage: Đề xuất tối đa 3 hành động cụ thể dựa trên root cause đã kiểm chứng và warning. Mỗi hành động ghi việc làm, owner/bộ phận phù hợp, kết quả đo được và thời hạn. Nếu root cause chưa đủ dữ liệu, đề xuất bước kiểm tra thay vì bịa nguyên nhân. Với Weekly Performance, ưu tiên tuần tới; với daily, ưu tiên hôm nay. Không nhắc revenue/doanh thu.

nodes.notes: Action Advisor dùng kết quả RCA thật thay vì warning thô.

nodes.name: Assemble Brief

parameters.jsCode:
const payload=$('Build Payload').first().json; const writer=$('Agent 1 - Brief Writer').first().json.output||$('Agent 1 - Brief Writer').first().json.text||''; const root=$('RCA Finalizer').first().json.root_cause_text||''; const advisor=$json.output||$json.text||''; const title=payload.report_mode==='weekly'?'📅 WEEKLY PERFORMANCE - '+payload.report_date:'☀️ DAILY 5 MINUTES BRIEF - '+payload.weekday_label+', '+payload.report_date; const finalText=title+'

'+writer+'

🔍 AI ANALYZE
'+root+'

🎯 SUGGESTED ACTION
'+advisor; return [{json:{run_id:payload.run_id,report_date:payload.report_date,sent_at:new Date().toISOString(),query_results:JSON.stringify({...payload,rca_history:$('RCA Finalizer').first().json.history||[]}),agent_output:finalText,status:'success',error_message:null}}];

nodes.notes: Ghép Writer + RCA findings + Advisor cho daily/weekly.
